newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand 95-octane gasoline sold at a premium.
newsitem.headline: Thailand 95-octane gasoline sold at a premium.

text.p: A Thai refiner has sold a cargo of 95-octane unleaded gasoline at a slight premium to Singapore spot quotes, traders said on Monday.
This is the first time that the refiner has sold a cargo at a premium since it started exporting in a big way in the middle of this year.
The 30,000-tonne cargo was sold at a 5-cent-per-barrel premium to Singapore quotes for early November lifting, on a free-on-board (fob) Thailand basis.
Taiwan bought 250,000-barrels of 95-octane reformate at around $23.80 per barrel for November 1-20 arrival, on a cost-and-freight basis to Keelung or Taichung.
Gasoline prices have firmed over the past two weeks in Singapore on tightening supplies due to exports to outside the region, traders said.
On Sept 23, a 50,000-barrel parcel of 92-octane unleaded gasoline was traded at $22.10 per barrel, for October 19-23 lifting fob Singapore.
On October 3, a similar 50,000-barrel parcel was traded at $23.05 per barrel for October 21-25 lifting, fob Singapore.
